subject: Clarifying the welcome packet
text:
I wanted to clarify the request from my last note, because I realize I may have jumped ahead. When I mentioned the welcome packet, I was not asking you to prepare every section right away. The main item we need first is the short participant roster, and only if you already have contact details collected in a simple spreadsheet. For the expense item, I should have explained that our usual printing allowance covered the flyers, but the larger posters we ordered turned into an unanticipated expense this month. That part is not urgent. I will ask the committee whether it can come from next month's reserve fund. If you can, please just confirm whether the roster is ready by Wednesday. No need to design anything fancy; plain columns with names, roles, and whether someone needs a reminder will do. I appreciate your patience while we sort out how this club handles its first welcome tasks. I will send a cleaner checklist after the meeting, and if any part still feels confusing, a quick call is fine. I also want to reassure you that the new client intake form can stay as it is. We can tidy the formatting later, once everyone knows what is truly required for the records box and the upcoming orientation. I hope this makes the next steps feel less crowded and easier to manage.

Thanks,
